persons.name: Lauren (catfishing and coercive control)
persons.harm: A supposed online boyfriend and his invented relatives subjected her to sexual pressure, threats of suicide, surveillance, and emotional abuse while the same person lived with her as her best friend.
persons.perpetrator_role: The catfisher, also posing as a romantic partner

contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_was_asked: Help with the mental effects of the threats and abuse
contacts.what_institution_did: Therapy did not help her understand the situation; medication relieved symptoms.
contacts.quote: I had to speak with a therapist on multiple occasions and had to speak with them about that. But at the time they didn't know what was going on and I didn't know what was going on so the therapy didn't really help. Medication helped and I'm still taking medication to this day.
contacts.what_happened_next: The abuse continued.
contacts.notes: Repeated consultations are described collectively; dates and providers cannot be separated reliably.

contacts.when: August 2023, before she identified the stolen photographs
contacts.what_was_asked: A restraining order and identification of the supposed boyfriend
contacts.what_institution_did: Checked the names, found no matching records, and told her there was nothing she could do at that visit.
contacts.quote: I asked if I could get a restraining order if I had enough information. I talked to the police. He said he had no idea. He could not find anybody in the system with that name.
contacts.what_happened_next: She researched the photographs and contacted the real man.
contacts.notes: The statement later recalled at 49:43 describes this same visit, not an additional contact.

contacts.institution: North Carolina restraining-order process, via police station
contacts.when: By August 24, 2023
contacts.what_was_asked: A restraining order to get away from her roommate
contacts.what_institution_did: Granted an order after she produced the identity evidence.
contacts.quote: I woke up, I went to the police station, got a restraining order. I told them at this point, she's a catfish. I have the photos, this is who she's pretending to be. I live with her, I need to get away from this. And they tell me that they are able to get a restraining order.
contacts.what_happened_next: She moved her belongings out with her mother.
contacts.notes: Her account describes obtaining the order at the station; later discussion identifies it as a 50B. No separate judicial text is read.

contacts.institution: Local magistrate, personally acquainted with the parties
contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_institution_did: Called her, discussed filing procedures, and expressed support.
contacts.quote: Well, I'm out of it now and I'm safe and everything is good. That's good. Yeah. That's good. That's good.
contacts.what_happened_next: She continued toward a hearing.
contacts.notes: Recorded conversation; earlier portions discuss avoiding a conflict of interest. No independent order or charge results from this call.

contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_institution_did: Reviewed messages but identified no charge beyond stalking.
contacts.quote: We sat with the detective. I met with her twice, I think, and she did not act like we had anything, any type of evidence.
contacts.what_happened_next: The misdemeanor case proceeded.
contacts.notes: Two meetings reported without distinct dates or different responses; represented together to avoid inventing details.

contacts.when: October 20, 2023 hearing
contacts.what_institution_did: Gave the papers a cursory review without understanding the history.
contacts.quote: The district attorney that we talked to, or the DA assistant, she took one look at our papers and she's like, what? I didn't know any of this was like, she had no clue what we were talking about or what we went through. And she had took two seconds to look over the paper before she decided what to do with our case.
contacts.what_happened_next: The women faced a choice between a misdemeanor disposition and seeking more serious charges.

contacts.when: October 20, 2023
contacts.what_institution_did: Offered a limited misdemeanor resolution or dismissal to pursue stronger charges; the women chose dismissal.
contacts.quote: So we had talked to the DA and if we had dropped the charges like we did that day, we were able to try to charge for something more, which was the intent.
contacts.what_happened_next: They tried to develop a felony case.
contacts.notes: Shared account from the co-victim. Dismissal was chosen after the offered alternative, not described as acquittal.

contacts.when: October 20, 2023
contacts.what_was_asked: Proceed with a meaningful criminal resolution
contacts.what_institution_did: Dismissed the misdemeanor so that the victims could try for a felony case.
contacts.quote: They dismissed the misdemeanor
contacts.what_happened_next: No felony charge is confirmed by the finale.
contacts.notes: Judicial disposition described by their friend; not a conviction. The offered alternative was a year away from social media and probation.

contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_institution_did: Said threats or extortion evidence were required and offered no further charge at that point.
contacts.quote: The DA told them if they don't have threats from [perpetrator] threatening to get nudes from them, like give me nudes or I'll tell your family or some sort of threat that there's nothing they could do about it or extortion.
contacts.what_happened_next: The group collected more evidence and publicized the story.

contacts.when: After the online relationship; exact date unclear
contacts.what_was_asked: Help understanding her withdrawal after the relationship
contacts.what_institution_did: Identified that staying home could reflect depression.
contacts.quote: I remember talking to a therapist sometime after [perpetrator]. Basically, the therapist said that just because you're comfortable staying home doesn't mean you're not depressed.
contacts.what_happened_next: Recovery continued.

contacts.when: Podcast investigation, spring 2024
contacts.what_was_asked: Reconsider the case with new victims and organized evidence
contacts.what_institution_did: Agreed to look at material, but described no new charge or active investigation at that call.
contacts.quote: I'm sure if you want to I can take a look at it. Like I said, I don't believe we saw any charges.
contacts.what_happened_next: The journalist sought records and contacted prosecutors.

contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_was_asked: Police report via a records request
contacts.what_institution_did: Provided the request route and subsequently released the report, which the podcast reviewed.
contacts.quote: I'll send that to you and then what I do is I have to get it approved by my captain whatever I release but it normally doesn't take long and then I'll get it right back to you.
contacts.what_happened_next: The journalist found errors and shared the report with the FBI.
contacts.notes: Administrative records assistance, not protection or prosecution.

contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_was_asked: Reopen investigation and review new evidence
contacts.what_institution_did: Agreed to alert the district attorney and discuss the new evidence.
contacts.quote: Yeah, let me, I'll email [the district attorney] and kind of just give him your email and tell him what's going on with the case and remind him of it.
contacts.what_happened_next: A meeting with the survivors was arranged.
contacts.notes: The name in the quoted sentence identifies another official and is redacted in final processing.

contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_was_asked: Federal investigation of the multistate abuse
contacts.what_institution_did: Referred the journalist to national intake and online reporting.
contacts.quote: But I mean, the best way to report this would be to go to our National Threat Assessment Center, because they're the ones that would, first of all, they're trained professionally to ask the right questions and get the right information on like me.
contacts.what_happened_next: She called the national line.

contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_institution_did: Documented the report, advised retaining evidence and reporting locally, and offered no investigative commitment.
contacts.quote: I can't say what will happen with the information you provided me other than it has been documented here within our system.
contacts.what_happened_next: The journalist contacted the Florida office.

contacts.when: As narrated; exact date not stated
contacts.what_was_asked: Investigation involving the stolen-image victim living in Florida
contacts.what_institution_did: Made a report; a special agent subsequently called back and interviewed that victim.
contacts.quote: Okay. Yeah, I will definitely get all this information documented for you. And I'm going to make a report out of this, okay?
contacts.what_happened_next: Evidence review remained ongoing.
contacts.notes: Interview of the man corroborates concrete investigative follow-up; no arrest or charge reported.

contacts.institution: Assistant District Attorney, another attorney, and sex-crimes officer
contacts.what_was_asked: Review the compiled evidence and pursue serious charges
contacts.what_institution_did: Met with the women, reviewed their evidence and identified possible charges.
contacts.quote: They took notes. They said they seemed very motivated. They were listening. They were taking them seriously.
contacts.what_happened_next: Four potential charges were discussed; no charging decision is reported by the finale.

contacts.when: By June 2024 finale
contacts.what_was_asked: Protect patients / prevent continued access after learning the conduct
contacts.what_institution_did: Dismissed the abuser after learning of the situation.
contacts.quote: She just recently moved back to North Carolina. As of like two weeks ago, she got a job, but she has already gotten released from that job due to this whole situation. They found out and they let her go.
contacts.what_happened_next: Licensing concerns remained unresolved.
contacts.notes: For Lauren this job was at the hospital treating her cousin's triplets. Does not establish that the children were harmed.

contacts.when: By June 2024 finale
contacts.what_institution_did: Multiple people contacted the board; no completed revocation or specific board response is reported.
contacts.quote: It looks like the respiratory board, after reaching out multiple times and multiple people reaching out, and hopefully they will take her license away, at least in North Carolina, so she can't work here, which would be really great.
contacts.what_happened_next: Revocation remained a hope, not a reported result.

persons.outcome_quote: Because they have they both have their restraining orders with her.
persons.decisive_work_quote: I go back home. I started reverse image searching all the photos that he had ever sent me. I found this website called facecheck.id and I found the real guy's photos through that.
persons.time_to_first_effective_action: By August 24, 2023, after her own investigation and initial unsuccessful police approach
persons.notes: She obtained a no-contact order and the hospital later removed a route of access to family, but reported proximity to her cousin's NICU children, online taunting, and continuing fear. Initial escape resulted from her research and family assistance; no conviction is reported. A final charging decision is not inferred. Some contacts are group accounts. Therapy, police and order chronology contains retrospective narration; dates not supplied are left unspecified.

coder_notes: All eight season chunks read in order in full, including advertisements, preview, educational episode, and the athlete crossover. Truncated tool output in chunk 8 was recovered by rereading lines 59–69. Unassigned INDEX read through line 18; ten potentially relevant educational episodes read in full. No other seasons, coders, branches, PRs, issues, external sources or referenced links consulted for coding. Advertisements and the explicitly next-season/next-episode promotional trailers are excluded as promotions, not stories told by this season. Fictional people, hypothetical cases and statistics are excluded. Prior harms without a separate story of what happened afterwards are retained as mentions rather than guessed records. Seven other children in the family-rupture episode cannot be individually distinguished and are counted as mentions. One person may have separate harm records. Group investigative contacts are copied only to victims explicitly part of that case; this is shared evidence, not multiple independent investigations. Repeated consultations and three denials are grouped only where the transcript gives no separable details. No unknown outcome is treated as proof that nothing happened: not_protected for unclear reach means no effective institutional action is evidenced, and notes preserve that uncertainty. Protective orders provide partial legal protection for the two recipients, while personal discovery and support ended the romantic impersonation. Continuing recovery, public validation and pending investigations do not prove a conviction. The athlete's assisted escape is a protective institutional action, distinct from his later harms. A non-survivor official name in one quote is replaced by a bracketed role to comply with the naming rule. Episode slugs are exact source identifiers, including aliases in titles.
